profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
• Software developer, experience with requirement analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and support using Object Oriented Methodologies and Java/J2EE technologies of Core business applications including Client-Server, Web Applications, Windows Applications and Web Services.
• Experienced working with highly constructed agile environment including daily scrum, retrospective meeting, sprint planning meeting, backlog refinement, knowledge sharing as well as two-week developer roundtable.
• Good understanding user requirements and translating business requirements into technical solutions with excellent problem solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
• Extensive experience and expertise in developing web applications using Core Java J2EE, advance Java, JDBC, Spring, SpringBoot, Hibernate ORM, SOAP, REST, JMS and XML.
• Experience with various RDBMS like MS SQL, Oracle, MySQL, PL/SQL and NoSQL database Mongo DB. 
• Well versed with collection framework with using data structures like Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, and Hash table, Trees, Tries and Collections API in Java.
• Highly experience with project management tool JIRA and also familiar with Rally, HP Quality Center and Bugzilla for defects and bugs tracking.
• Experienced using Postman and SOAP UI for java based Application Programming Interface (API) testing using JSON test data. Integrated Swagger with Spring Boot application to define model data as well as response data using JSON.
• Experience with replicating and reproducing defects or bugs on various version of application, writing manual test cases and maintaining required documentation including JIRA and Excel.
• Good experience with development methodologies like Agile (SCRUM), Waterfall using Test-driven development (TDD) and Behavior Driven Development (BDD). 
• Familiar with various automation testing frameworks such as Cucumber, Gherkins and Selenium Automation Testing Framework with java.
• Experienced working with different version controls like GIT, SVN to control source code and Good working knowledge of Build Tool like MAVEN and Gradle.
• Familiar with Messaging Technologies like Kafka, IBM MQ.
• Hand on experience in writing Python scripts.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer at CenturyLink
positions.description:
- Working in AGILE based development Environment and participate in Daily Scrum, 
	Backlog refinement, Sprint Planning and Release.
- Automation of Order Processing using Business Process Management Tool Camunda.
- Docker container images, tagging, pushing images, integration of Spring-boot.
- Developed Queue (IBM MQ) based Integration Micro Services with Spring Boot.
- Using Kafka messaging preventing data loss of the transaction and system more reliable.
- Create Microservices architecture using Spring-boot, Maven, Kafka, My SQL, Restful Web Services. 
- Implementing JUnit to achieve 80% code coverage
- Create Jenkin pipeline for Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CICD)
- Deploying the application in testing environment
- Involvement in user testing and deployment in production
- Write Python script to support and correct Production fallouts and Incidents
